"''I have friends everywhere.|Niki and Andor|audio=Niki-Andor-IHFE.flac|}} '''Niki''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who was proprietor of the [[Niki-Bon Travel Agency]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. In [[3 BBY]], she and the other proprietor, [[Bon]], were in the agency's back room when the [[Axis network]] member [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] knocked on the building's [[Viewport|window]]. When Niki emerged and let him in, Andor asked to travel to the planet [[Ghorman]], and after he used the code phrase "I have friends everywhere," Niki called to Bon to see what they had for the world. Andor later left and traveled to Ghorman. ==Biography== {{Quote|Bon! What do we have for Ghorman?''"
[Bon grunts]|quoteend=0|Niki and Bon|audio=Niki-Bon-IHFE.flac|}} [[File:Niki-Andor-FriendsEverywhere.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Niki stands with her arms crossed in a dressing gown facing Cassian Andor in the Niki-Bon Travel Agency.|Niki helped Cassian Andor secure passage to Ghorman.]] Niki was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who, alongside the [[Bon's species|alien]] [[Bon]], was the proprietor of the eponymous [[Niki-Bon Travel Agency]] on an upper level of{{Databank|niki-bon-travel-agency|Niki-Bon travel agency}} the [[planet]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[Coruscant]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. The pair resided in a room in the back of the office and in [[3 BBY]],{{AndorDate|205}} were back there together laughing when [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], a member of the rebel [[Axis network]], arrived at the travel agency. Andor knocked on the building's [[Viewport|window]], causing Niki to tell Bon to stop what he was doing. She then emerged from the back room, with messy [[hair]] up in a bun while tightening her [[Clothing|dressing gown]], to turn on the lights and let Andor in. The new arrival stated that he wished to travel to [[Ghorman]], a planet''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' in the [[Colonies]],[[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]] and Niki asked if it was to visit friends there. Andor questioned why she wished to know, and Niki claimed to be curious by nature. This caused Andor to chuckle, and he responded with the phrase "I have friends everywhere," which was used by members of the network to identify one another or allies.{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} Holding her [[mouth]] screwed to one side, Niki then called back to Bon and asked what they had for Ghorman, prompting the [[alien]] to emerge and grunt at their guest. Andor later left the travel agency with a new piece of luggage and traveled to the [[Coruscant Eastern Spaceport]], where he departed for Ghorman. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|[Niki laughs]
[Andor knocks on the window]
''«Stop! Someone here!»''|quotestart=0|quoteend=0|italics=0|Niki whispers to Bon|audio=Niki-Stop-IHFE.flac|}} Niki and Bon were willing to help a potential customer at any [[Standard hour|hour]] for the right price. Niki had [[Color|black]] hair, tan skin, and brown [[eye]]s. ==Skills and abilities== She spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard]] to Andor but used a different [[language]] when speaking to Bon. ==Equipment== Niki wore a red dressing gown when talking to Andor. ==Behind the scenes== Niki was portrayed by [[Pui Fan Lee]] in "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]," the fifth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], which aired on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} The character's name is not spoken in the episode but is listed in the credits. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Niki|imagecat=Images of Niki}} *{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-2|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 2 Trivia}} {{C|In [[Niki-Bon Travel Agency]]'s name}} *{{Databank|niki-bon-travel-agency|Niki-Bon travel agency}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ნიკი (პერსონაჟი) }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]]
